## The problem

One execution table must merge all three execution stores and say how
each row is linked — today nothing does. `ingest_run` is **shared**
bookkeeping (one row can carry several scheduled invocations; its clock
is the DB's, not the execution's), `ingest_run_completion` closes the
run, and the per-execution evidence lives in the WORM
`ops/runs/<source>/<date>/<ts>.json` objects and the 90 repo-pinned
`docs/build/reports/live_runs/*.json` records — with no queryable,
append-only home, and no honest way to say "this row came from a WORM
object, a repo record, or an execution we could not match to a shared
run" (K10 §18 C-13/C-14 — shared-run values must never read as the
execution's own).

## What ships

- **The sqitch change `ingest_run_report`** (`db/deploy|revert|verify/`
  + one appended `sqitch.plan` line — lines 44–52 untouched, C-10) —
  append-only by immutability trigger (UPDATE/DELETE refuse); nullable
  `run_id` (C-14); `link_basis` closed vocabulary (`live`,
  `backfill:claims-in-window`, `backfill:sole-candidate`,
  `unmatched:<reason>` — the P31.2 matcher verdict classes,
  `repo_record`); `clock_basis` (`db`/`run_row`/`git_only`);
  `fetches`, `records_emitted`, `duration_seconds`,
  `robots_outcomes jsonb` (`{host: {obeyed|disallowed|unavailable|
  disregarded: n}}`), `refusal_classes jsonb`, `rate_limit_events`,
  `disappearances`, `document_outcomes jsonb`, `quota_reached`,
  `budget_reached`, `error_class` (the S-4 closed vocabulary, mirrored
  in a CHECK), the **`per_fetch jsonb` column landed unwritten** (the
  PKG-12 telemetry writer is row 312's — the "when present" contract
  lands here), `backfilled_from` (partial UNIQUE → the `+0` re-run) and
  `recorded_at`. Two partial unique keys: one live row per `run_id`,
  one row per `backfilled_from` URI.
- **`db.run_report.append_report`** — the single INSERT path; JSONB
  serialized safely; `ON CONFLICT` under the unique keys makes a repeat
  `+0`; unevidenced fields stay `NULL`, never zero-shaped.
- **The `scheduled-ingest` writer** — after `store_run_row` lands the
  WORM object, `store_run_report` appends the `link_basis='live'` row
  for THAT execution (same `run_id`, same WORM URI where applicable).
  Insert-only and never fatal — a miss is loud on stderr and the
  backfill mints the row from the WORM object (the queued leg deploys
  the table before the writer first runs).
- **`sig-ops backfill-run-reports`** — reads every WORM
  `ops/runs` object (the count is re-derived from a live listing, never
  assumed), reuses the P31.2 matcher (`plan_backfill` /
  `count_inserted_in_windows` / `WormRunRow`): rows already carrying a
  live URI link to that run; evidence-matched rows get
  `backfill:claims-in-window` / `backfill:sole-candidate`; rows the
  matcher cannot evidence get `unmatched:<reason>` with `run_id NULL` —
  the row exists per execution no matter the link (C-14). The repo-pinned
  live-run records land as `link_basis='repo_record'` +
  `clock_basis='git_only'` — never dressed up as DB-clock executions.
  `--dry-run` plans and counts without appending; `--role` does the
  `SET ROLE sig_materialize` for the hosted least-privilege run
  (ADR-103). The run prints `reconcile_run_reports` — counts per
  `link_basis`, execution double-count detection (a live row plus a
  backfilled row for the same `run_id` is flagged), unmatched and
  repo-record rows counted separately.
- **Honest derivation** — `ops.run_report` maps the fetch_record's
  connector outcomes into `policy.transparency`'s closed public
  vocabulary (`no_policy_4xx`/`allowed`→`obeyed`,
  `disallowed`→`disallowed`, `unretrievable`→`unavailable`,
  `robots_disregarded`→`disregarded`); hosts come from S-6
  `upstream_host` (never a URL); quarantine contributes counts by
  reason class only — the payload is never in the report (J3 §3.5);
  `error_class` uses the S-4 closed classes; a field the run cannot
  evidence stays `NULL`.

## The recorded boundary — what this does NOT do

- **No `per_fetch` writer.** Row 312 (P35.34) fills the column; this
  row lands the column and the "when present" contract — every writer
  here leaves it `NULL`, asserted.
- **No `v_transparency_*` views, no export artifacts** — rows 311/313;
  **no execution-keyed public history** — P36.46 (row 389, the
  SIG-TRANSP-036 owner). Consequently **`sig_read_public` is NOT
  granted** — the grants mirror `ingest_run_completion` narrowed
  (`sig_ingest` SELECT+INSERT, `sig_materialize` INSERT,
  `sig_read_restricted`/`sig_read_sealed`/`sig_export` SELECT) and the
  exact-surface test `test_public_read_allowlist` still passes.
- **Nothing existing is altered** — `ingest_run`,
  `ingest_run_completion`, `ingest_run_capture` untouched; no source
  flip, no human gate ticked.
- **No live leg** — the hosted `sqitch deploy` + `backfill-run-reports`
  run queues in RETURN PASS as `P35.32-ingest-run-report-live` with the
  verbatim re-run prompt `implement-spec
  spec=docs/tickets/310_P35.32__ingest-run-report.md
  live_verification=true` (AR-2 restore point → AR-3 window → deploy →
  `+0` re-run proof → read-back).
